free_text: A repeat biopsy is indicated because the patient has a PI-RADS 4 lesion and a rising PSA trajectory from 4.3 ng/mL to 5.3 ng/mL over three months. This clinical picture, combined with the documented positive prior biopsy, supports the need for further histological assessment. The evidence converged on the need for a repeat biopsy based on the established pattern seen in similar cases.
